apply_conflicts: One conflict in AIDecisionMaker.gd constants block: the design's FIX_CHARGE_TARGET / CHARGE_TARGET_OVERKILL_RATIO constants and 1.56.8's FIX_WAAAGH_ADVANCE_CHARGE constant were added at the same spot; kept both (no logic overlap). Code hunks applied cleanly.

required_changes.change: Depletion gate on both arms via one shared helper (ct_hp <= 0.5 x starting wounds, dead models included; keep 2x ratio) + unit test (5 CG vs full 6-W BC and full 4-model Prosecutors stay uncapped, declaration = FIX 0)
required_changes.how_or_why_not: New _charge_target_overkill_gate() read by _score_charge_target (CT-OVERKILL) and _evaluate_best_charge (ct_overkill flag); CHARGE_TARGET_DEPLETED_SHARE=0.5. Test: 13.89 vs 6 W (2.3x) and 8.68 vs 4 W (2.2x) uncapped; declaration equals FIX=0.

required_changes.change: Kill-value exemption: CHARACTER, kill_keywords, marked_targets, kill_big_units_min, kill_near_objectives within OBJECTIVE_CONTROL_RANGE_PX
required_changes.how_or_why_not: In the helper, over every member of the folded Attached unit, from _get_secondary_awareness(player). Tests: CHARACTER, marked target and kill keyword each restore full ch_damage. Real save s7431 r3 P1 keeps [U_BLADE_CHAMPION_A_P2] (unit test + replay).

required_changes.change: Attached units: ct_hp and starting wounds over the whole Attached unit (both linkage sides, AI-side _attached_unit_target_id); CT-COMBO never removes a member sharing an Attached unit with another member
required_changes.how_or_why_not: Helper folds host + attachment_data.attached_characters + units with attached_to == host. CT-COMBO keeps a gated target whose _attached_unit_target_id equals another target's. Unit test with a synthetic non-CHARACTER attached member (a real leader is a CHARACTER and exempt anyway). Bench fixtures have no Attached units, so this never fires there.

required_changes.change: CT-COMBO only for targets the charger cannot engage together (keep a gated target within ER 2" of another combo target)
required_changes.how_or_why_not: Gated target kept when _get_closest_model_distance_inches to any other scored target <= GameConstants.engagement_range_inches(). Unit test: co-engageable remnant + fresh stays a combo, equal to FIX=0.

required_changes.change: Decision-level log: compute the pick with the fix off; one '[CHARGE_TARGET] changed: <old> -> <new>' line only when the declaration differs; keep per-evaluation lines
required_changes.how_or_why_not: Base pick tracked in the same loop (uncapped score re-scored with a _ct_suspend flag, base combo on uncapped scores with all targets), compared after the threshold is known. Per-evaluation lines kept but retagged [CHARGE_TARGET_EVAL] so the reach gate counts only changed decisions (the finalizer brief: ONE [CHARGE_TARGET] line per changed decision). Verified: s7480 log prints 'changed: U_ALLARUS_CUSTODIANS_A_P2 [U_ALLARUS_CUSTODIANS_A, U_ALLARUS_CUSTODIANS_A_L2] -> ... [U_BLADE_CHAMPION_A]', the logged base choice.

risks: Reach too low for the bench: 0.33 changed declarations per game (cus 0.5, asy 0.5, ork 0) - below the protocol-v2 1.0 gate, in line with the judge's 0.5-2 estimate after the required gates.

CT-COMBO defect seen in the gate (cus M1): when the dropped remnant still wins as a single declaration, the fix only removes the other target from the declaration (loses the extra option) and that charge then failed its move after the roll. Suggested narrowing if revived: apply CT-COMBO only when the unit's resulting pick is not the dropped target itself (else keep the base combo).

The finding rests on one clear 24-seed position whose alternative kills a CHARACTER while P2 holds Assassination; part of the +5.75 may be mission/focus value the cap does not model (judge caveat). The 24 fresh-seed and horizon-2 re-checks of s7480 are not part of this run.
Attached-unit folding and kill-card exemptions are unexercised on the bench (no Attached units; kill cards only via the 11e deck).
Per-evaluation lines retagged [CHARGE_TARGET_EVAL] (kept, not removed) so the reach count is decision-level.
